youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用搬新家情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從打包貼標籤租卡車、清點件數搬運上車、到新家開箱組裝傢俱，最後辦地址水電網路過戶、跟鄰居寒暄認識，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Moving to a New Apartment phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the whole journey: packing and labeling boxes, renting the truck, counting and loading, unboxing and assembling furniture at the new place, then changing your address, setting up utilities and wifi, and meeting the neighbors. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we starting the packing today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi ˈstɑrtɪŋ ðə ˈpækɪŋ təˈdeɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we begin with the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wi bɪˈɡɪn wɪð ðə ˈkɪtʃən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have enough moving boxes?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi hæv ɪˈnʌf ˈmuvɪŋ ˈbɑksɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I ordered sixty online last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔrdərd ˈsɔsti ˌɑnˈlaɪn læst wiːk/
dialogue.zh: 上週我在網上訂了六十個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, they should arrive tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ðeɪ ʃʊd əˈraɪv təˈmɑroʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you buy tape and markers too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju baɪ teɪp ænd ˈmɑrkərz tu/
dialogue.zh: 膠帶和麥克筆也買了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I got three rolls of wide tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɑt θri roʊlz əv waɪd teɪp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What about bubble wrap for glasses?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈbʌbəl ræp fər ˈɡlæsɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is a big roll under the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə bɪɡ roʊl ˈʌndər ðə ˈteɪbəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, let's clear these shelves first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt lɛts klɪr ðiz ʃɛlvz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 正好，先把這些架子清空。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we wrap each plate separately?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ræp itʃ pleɪt ˈsɛpərətli/
dialogue.zh: 盤子要一個個包起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, put paper between every two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pʊt ˈpeɪpər bɪˈtwin ˈɛvri tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These coffee mugs need extra care.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ˈkɔfi mʌɡz nid ˈɛkstrə kɛr/
dialogue.zh: 這些馬克杯要特別小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrap them twice, then mark fragile.
dialogue.phonetic: /ræp ðɛm twaɪs ðɛn mɑrk ˈfrædʒəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fragile, this side up, like this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfrædʒəl ðɪs saɪd ʌp laɪk ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 易碎、此面朝上，這樣寫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, write that on both sides.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli raɪt ðæt ɑn boʊθ saɪdz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These pots are too big for this box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz pɑts ɑr tu bɪɡ fər ðɪs bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 這些鍋子對這箱子太大了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the tall wardrobe box instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə tɔl ˈwɔrˌdroʊb bɑks ɪnˈstɛd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we still need the old blender?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi stɪl nid ði oʊld ˈblɛndər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pack it with the coffee maker.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pæk ɪt wɪð ðə ˈkɔfi ˈmeɪkər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This box is getting really heavy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bɑks ɪz ˈɡɛtɪŋ ˈrɪli ˈhɛvi/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mix heavy books with lighter things.
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪks ˈhɛvi bʊks wɪð ˈlaɪtər θɪŋz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you tape the bottom for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju teɪp ðə ˈbɑtəm fər mi/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, cross it for more strength.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr krɔs ɪt fər mɔr strɛŋθ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Number the boxes so nothing gets lost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbər ðə ˈbɑksɪz soʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ ɡɛts lɔst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will write number ten on this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl raɪt ˈnʌmbər tɛn ɑn ðɪs wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about these old magazines?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðiz oʊld ˌmæɡəˈzinz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Recycle them, no one reads those now.
dialogue.phonetic: /riˈsaɪkəl ðɛm noʊ wʌn ridz ðoz naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we donate these extra clothes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ˈdoʊneɪt ðiz ˈɛkstrə kloʊðz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, call the shelter this afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs kɔl ðə ˈʃɛltər ðɪs ˌæftərˈnun/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep only the clothes you actually wear.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ˈoʊnli ðə kloʊðz ju ˈæktʃuəli wɛr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easier said than done, but fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizər sɛd ðæn dʌn bʌt faɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This lamp stopped working last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs læmp stɑpt ˈwɜrkɪŋ læst mʌnθ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it by the door for trash pickup.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt baɪ ðə dɔr fər træʃ ˈpɪkˌʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you taking grandma's dishes?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈteɪkɪŋ ˈɡræməz ˈdɪʃɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, wrap them very carefully.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔrs ræp ðɛm ˈvɛri ˈkɛrfəli/
dialogue.zh: 當然是要，包得特別小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pack the towels inside one big bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæk ðə ˈtaʊəlz ɪnˈsaɪd wʌn bɪɡ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 毛巾全裝進一個大袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, they work as padding too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə ðeɪ wɜrk æz ˈpædɪŋ tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These cables and wires are a mess.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz ˈkeɪbəlz ænd ˈwaɪərz ɑr ə mɛs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put each set in its own labeled bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt itʃ sɛt ɪn ɪts oʊn ˈleɪbəld bæɡ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take a photo before unplugging the TV.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ bɪˈfɔr ʌnˈplʌɡɪŋ ðə ˌtiˈvi/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, that saves us an hour later.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ðæt seɪvz ʌs ən ˈaʊər ˈleɪtər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My laptop charger stays in my backpack.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈlæpˌtɑp ˈtʃɑrdʒər steɪz ɪn maɪ ˈbækˌpæk/
dialogue.zh: 筆電充電器放我的背包。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too, plus the small hard drive.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu plʌz ðə smɔl hɑrd draɪv/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't forget your medicine and toothbrush.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt fərˈɡɛt jɔr ˈmɛdsən ænd ˈtuːθbrʌʃ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They travel with us, never the truck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈtrævəl wɪð ʌs ˈnɛvər ðə trʌk/
dialogue.zh: 這些跟我們走，不上卡車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Label every box with its room name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪbəl ˈɛvri bɑks wɪð ɪts rum neɪm/
dialogue.zh: 每個箱子都標上房間名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue for the bedroom, red for kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu fər ðə ˈbɛdˌrum rɛd fər ˈkɪtʃən/
dialogue.zh: 藍色標臥室，紅色標廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will use green for office stuff.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl juz ɡrin fər ˈɔfɪs stʌf/
dialogue.zh: 書房的東西我用綠色標。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Colors will save us so much time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʌlərz wɪl seɪv ʌs soʊ mʌtʃ taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 顏色幫我們省超多時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many boxes do we have so far?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɑksɪz du wi hæv soʊ fɑr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I count twenty-two near the front door.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kaʊnt ˈtwɛnti tu nɪr ðə frʌnt dɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We still have to pack the whole garage.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi stɪl hæv tə pæk ðə hoʊl ɡəˈrɑʒ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's do it tomorrow right after lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts du ɪt təˈmɑroʊ raɪt ˈæftər lʌntʃ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we really need that old bike?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈrɪli nid ðæt oʊld baɪk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, let's sell it online tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ lɛts sɛl ɪt ˌɑnˈlaɪn təˈnaɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone already asked about the bookshelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn ɔlˈrɛdi æskt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈbʊkˌʃɛlf/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sell that one too, it won't fit there.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛl ðʌt wʌn tu ɪt woʊnt fɪt ðɛr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you measure the new living room?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju ˈmɛʒər ðə nu ˈlɪvɪŋ rum/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, our couch fits, but just barely.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈaʊər kaʊtʃ fɪts bʌt dʒʌst ˈbɛrli/
dialogue.zh: 量了，沙發放得下但很擠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good news, the truck is set for Saturday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd nuz ðə trʌk ɪz sɛt fər ˈsætərˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好消息，卡車確定租在週六。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did we book the biggest one?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi bʊk ðə ˈbɪɡɪst wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我們訂了最大的那台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixteen feet, with a big flat floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌsɪksˈtin fiːt wɪð ə bɪɡ flæt flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 十六英尺，車板又大又平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is the mileage unlimited on it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈmaɪlɪʤ ənˈlɪmɪtɪd ɑn ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, two hundred free miles, then pay.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tu ˈhʌndrəd friː maɪlz ðɛn peɪ/
dialogue.zh: 含兩百英里，超了就付錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is plenty for the drive over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈplɛnti fər ðə draɪv ˈoʊvər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time do we pick up the truck?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt taɪm du wi pɪk ʌp ðə trʌk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight in the morning, sharp, no excuses.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ ʃɑrp noʊ ɪkˈskjuzɪz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need anything else for pickup?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ˈɛnɪθɪŋ ɛls fər ˈpɪkˌʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just your license and one credit card.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst jɔr ˈlaɪsəns ænd wʌn ˈkrɛdɪt kærd/
dialogue.zh: 駕照加一張信用卡就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you reserve the freight elevator?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju ˈrɛzərv ðə freɪt ˈɛləˌveɪtər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Saturday from eight until noon.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈsætərˌdeɪ frʌm eɪt ʌnˈtɪl nun/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Moving day is Saturday, I can't wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmuvɪŋ deɪ ɪz ˈsætərˌdeɪ aɪ kænt weɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I already asked my boss for that day off.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɔlˈrɛdi æskt maɪ bɔs fər ðæt deɪ ɔf/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are your friends still coming to help?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr jɔr frɛndz stɪl ˈkʌmɪŋ tə hɛlp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two of them with a small van.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu əv ðɛm wɪð ə smɔl væn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Extra hands will make it much faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛkstrə hænz wɪl meɪk ɪt mʌtʃ ˈfæstər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll make coffee and snacks for everyone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl meɪk ˈkɔfi ænd snæks fər ˈɛvriˌwʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And pizza for lunch, that's my job.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈpitsə fər lʌntʃ ðæts maɪ dʒɑb/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, water bottles too, it gets hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil ˈwɔtər ˈbɑtəlz tu ɪt ɡɛts hɑt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's walk through the checklist line by line.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts wɔk θru ðə ˈtʃɛkˌlɪst laɪn baɪ laɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Boxes, tape, truck, elevator, helpers, snacks.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɑksɪz teɪp trʌk ˈɛləˌveɪtər ˈhɛlpərz snæks/
dialogue.zh: 紙箱、膠帶、車、梯、人手、點心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the plants? We own twelve.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə plænts wi oʊn twɛlv/
dialogue.zh: 植物怎麼辦？我們有十二盆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They ride in our car, not the truck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ raɪd ɪn ˈaʊər kɑr nɑt ðə trʌk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the storage unit ready as planned?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈstɔrɪdʒ ˈjunɪt ˈrɛdi æz plænd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the key is in your top drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə ki ɪz ɪn jɔr tɑp drɔr/
dialogue.zh: 好了，鑰匙在你上層抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old furniture goes to storage first.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ˈfɜrnɪtʃər ɡoʊz tə ˈstɔrɪdʒ fɜrst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the things we truly want to keep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə θɪŋz wi ˈtruɪ wɑnt tə kip/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm tired already, and we've barely started.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ˈtaɪərd ɔlˈrɛdi ænd wiv ˈbɛrli ˈstɑrtɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down five minutes, you earned it.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt daʊn faɪv ˈmɪnɪts ju ɜrnd ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the very last kitchen box taped?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈvɛri læst ˈkɪtʃən bɑks teɪpt/
dialogue.zh: 最後一箱廚房封好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that closes out the whole kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt ˈkloʊzɪz aʊt ðə hoʊl ˈkɪtʃən/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Office boxes next, after dinner tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔfɪs bɑksɪz nɛkst ˈæftər ˈdɪnər təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 書房的箱子今晚飯後再收。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll set the lamp aside for packing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl sɛt ðə læmp əˈsaɪd fər ˈpækɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need scissors for this tape?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ˈsɪzərz fər ðɪs teɪp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the box edge cuts it fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðə bɑks ɛdʒ kʌts ɪt faɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything on today's list is checked off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɑn təˈdeɪz lɪst ɪz tʃɛkt ɔf/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow we finish the bedroom and garage.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ wi ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈbɛdˌrum ænd ɡəˈrɑʒ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, the big move is coming.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt ðə bɪɡ muv ɪz ˈkʌmɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep well, I'll start the coffee early.
dialogue.phonetic: /slip wɛl aɪl stɑrt ðə ˈkɔfi ˈɜrli/
dialogue.zh: 你也早點睡，我早起煮咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the truck is pulling up right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə trʌk ɪz ˈpʊlɪŋ ʌp raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 看，卡車現在開到門口了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, they are early, that's great.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðeɪ ɑr ˈɜrli ðæts ɡreɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning, ready to load up?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈrɛdi tə loʊd ʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, everything is packed and numbered.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪz pækt ænd ˈnʌmbərd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the list says sixty, count please.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðə lɪst sɛz ˈsɔsti kaʊnt pliz/
dialogue.zh: 清單寫六十箱，請點一下數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two... forty so far.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tu ˈfɔrti soʊ fɑr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time, we have all morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr taɪm wi hæv ɔl ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢點，整個上午都是我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fifty-two now, five more in the bedroom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪfti tu naʊ faɪv mɔr ɪn ðə ˈbɛdˌrum/
dialogue.zh: 五十二箱，臥室還有五個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty, exactly as planned, nice work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔsti ɪɡˈzæktli æz plænd naɪs wɜrk/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing missing, every number is here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈmɪsɪŋ ˈɛvri ˈnʌmbər ɪz hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Start with the big pieces, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt wɪð ðə bɪɡ ˈpisɪz pliz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sofa first, then the bed frame.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsoʊfə fɜrst ðɛn ðə bɛd freɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrap the sofa in a moving pad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ræp ðə ˈsoʊfə ɪn ə ˈmuvɪŋ pæd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already done, we always pad furniture.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔlˈrɛdi dʌn wi ˈɔlweɪz pæd ˈfɜrnɪtʃər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sofa legs need to come off first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsoʊfə lɛɡz nid tə kʌm ɔf fɜrst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have the tools, give me a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ðə tulz ɡiv mi ə ˈmɪnɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put all the screws in one bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ɔl ðə skruz ɪn wʌn bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 螺絲全部裝進一個袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Taped under the cushion, safe and sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪpt ˈʌndər ðə ˈkʊʃən seɪf ænd saʊnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the mattress fit down these stairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə ˈmætrɪs fɪt daʊn ðiz stɛrz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we will lift it from the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wi wɪl lɪft ɪt frʌm ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不行，我們從窗戶吊下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, this hallway turn is tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn ðɪs ˈhɔlˌweɪ tərn ɪz taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 等等，走廊轉角真的很窄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tilt it up, slow, easy does it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪlt ɪt ʌp sloʊ ˈizi dʌz ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch the doorframe, don't scrape it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə ˈdɔrˌfreɪm doʊnt skreɪp ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're through, no mark at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr θru noʊ mɑrk æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 過去了，一點痕跡都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the fridge empty and unplugged?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə frɪdʒ ˈɛmpti ænd ʌnˈplʌɡd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I defrosted it last night.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ diˈfrɔstəd ɪt læst naɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Prop its door open for the ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɑp ɪts dɔr ˈoʊpən fər ðə raɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One rubber band keeps it in place.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈrʌbər bænd kips ɪt ɪn pleɪs/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That glass table needs special care.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɡlæs ˈteɪbəl nidz ˈspɛʃəl kɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那張玻璃桌要特別照顧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every corner wears a foam pad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri ˈkɔrnər wɛrz ə foʊm pæd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy things always load on first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi θɪŋz ˈɔlweɪz loʊd ɑn fɜrst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we strap them to the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi stræp ðɛm tə ðə wɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the fragile boxes off the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðə ˈfrædʒəl ˈbɑksɪz ɔf ðə ˈbɑtəm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We set those last, right on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi sɛt ðoz læst raɪt ɑn tɑp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wardrobe boxes must stay upright.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔrˌdroʊb ˈbɑksɪz mʌst steɪ ˈʌpˌraɪt/
dialogue.zh: 衣櫥箱要一直保持直立。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They line up flat against one side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ laɪn ʌp flæt əˈɡɛnst wʌn saɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you carry two chairs at once?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ˈkæri tu tʃɛrz æt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 你能一次搬兩張椅子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, and the little stools too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr ænd ðə ˈlɪtəl stulz tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every bed frame piece has a tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri bɛd freɪm pis hæz ə tæɡ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The tags match, so setup is easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tæɡz mætʃ soʊ ˈsɛtˌʌp ɪz ˈizi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the buyer take the dresser already?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈbaɪər teɪk ðə ˈdrɛsər ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 買家把五斗櫃搬走了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This morning, cash paid, nothing left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ kæʃ peɪd ˈnʌθɪŋ lɛft/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That room feels twice as big now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt rum filz twaɪs æz bɪɡ naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the tears, the truck still waits.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə tɪrz ðə trʌk stɪl weɪts/
dialogue.zh: 先忍住不捨，卡車還在等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you check every closet one last time?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju tʃɛk ˈɛvri ˈklɑsət wʌn læst taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 每個衣櫃最後都查了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and the bathroom cabinet too.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ænd ðə ˈbæθˌrum ˈkæbənət tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anything left inside the oven?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪθɪŋ lɛft ɪnˈsaɪd ði ˈʌvən/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing, it's clean and switched off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪts klin ænd swɪtʃt ɔf/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please shut off the lights in each room.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz ʃʌt ɔf ðə laɪts ɪn itʃ rum/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lights and fans are all off now.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪts ænd fænz ɑr ɔl ɔf naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take photos of the meters before we leave.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ˈfoʊtoʊz əv ðə ˈmitərz bɪˈfɔr wi liv/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, that protects our whole deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ðæt prəˈtɛkts ˈaʊər hoʊl dɪˈpɑzɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gas, water, electric, all checked?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡæs ˈwɔtər ɪˈlɛktrɪk ɔl tʃɛkt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every valve is off, I double-checked.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri vælv ɪz ɔf aɪ ˈdʌbəlˌtʃɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 每個開關都關了，我複查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we return the keys today?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi rɪˈtɜrn ðə kiz təˈdeɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The manager comes to collect at four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmænɪdʒər kʌmz tə kəˈlɛkt æt fɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One last look around the old place.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn læst lʊk əˈraʊnd ði oʊld pleɪs/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Windows closed, stove off, all clear.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪnˌdoʊz kloʊzd stoʊv ɔf ɔl klɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say goodbye to our little balcony.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ˌɡʊdˈbaɪ tə ˈaʊər ˈlɪtəl ˈbælkəni/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All those slow morning coffees here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ðoz sloʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈkɔfiz hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡喝的那些慢早晨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the truck doors locked and sealed?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə trʌk dɔrz lɑkt ænd sild/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Locked tight, the seal is on.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑkt taɪt ðə sil ɪz ɑn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll pull in before the truck.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil pʊl ɪn bɪˈfɔr ðə trʌk/
dialogue.zh: 我們會比卡車早一點到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send me the new address again.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd mi ðə nu əˈdrɛs əˈɡɛn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Texted, with the gate code below.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɛkstɪd wɪð ðə ɡeɪt koʊd bɪˈloʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that gets us straight in.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ðæt ɡɛts ʌs streɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 正好，這樣我們能直接開進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our back seat holds bags and plants.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər bæk sit hoʊldz bæɡ ænd plænts/
dialogue.zh: 後座塞滿隨身袋和植物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your guitar rests in my lap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd jɔr ɡɪˈtɑr rɛsts ɪn maɪ læp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Family photos ride with us, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæməli ˈfoʊtoʊz raɪd wɪð ʌs raɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the box under your left hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə bɑks ˈʌndər jɔr lɛft hænd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Traffic is light, we're lucky today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtræfɪk ɪz laɪt wɪr ˈlʌki təˈdeɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes and we'll be there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ænd wil bi ðɛr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The highway is faster than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈhaɪˌweɪ ɪz ˈfæstər ðæn aɪ θɔt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call ahead, the parking spot is reserved.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl əˈhɛd ðə ˈpɑrkɪŋ spɑt ɪz rɪˈzərvd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spot twelve, right by the entrance.
dialogue.phonetic: /spɑt twɛlv raɪt baɪ ði ˈɛntrəns/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew will turn in any minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kru wɪl tɜrn ɪn ˈɛni ˈmɪnɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we unlock the side gate now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ʌnˈlɑk ðə saɪd ɡeɪt naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so the truck rolls straight in.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs soʊ ðə trʌk roʊlz streɪt ɪn/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here they come, the truck is turning.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðeɪ kʌm ðə trʌk ɪz ˈtɜrnɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave them in, I'll grab the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪv ðɛm ɪn aɪl ɡræb ðə lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 你去揮手引導，我來拿清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, did we sweep the old floors well?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt dɪd wi swip ði oʊld flɔrz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 等等，舊家的地板我們掃好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, spotless, the landlord will say so.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈspɑtlɪs ðə ˈlændˌlɔrd wil seɪ soʊ/
dialogue.zh: 掃過了，一塵不染，房東也會這麼說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A clean place means a full refund.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə klin pleɪs minz ə fʊl rɪˈfʌnd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worth the extra hour we spent.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrθ ði ˈɛkstrə ˈaʊər wi spɛnt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the trash bags make it out too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə træʃ bæɡz meɪk ɪt aʊt tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All done, by bin number two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl dʌn baɪ bɪn ˈnʌmbər tu/
dialogue.zh: 都弄好了，就在二號桶邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our cat sleeps in her carrier now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər kæt slips ɪn hɜr ˈkɛriər naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 貓咪在航空箱裡睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, pets always ride in the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pɛts ˈɔlweɪz raɪd ɪn ðə kɑr/
dialogue.zh: 正好，毛孩就該坐私家車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Movers, the ramp is already down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmuzərz ðə ræmp ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi daʊn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First the sofa, straight through the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst ðə ˈsoʊfə streɪt θru ðə hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 沙發先下車，直接推進大廳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The straps are off, nothing moved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stræps ɑr ɔf ˈnʌθɪŋ muvd/
dialogue.zh: 綁帶都拆了，東西沒有一樣晃動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the fragile boxes stayed on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðə ˈfrædʒəl bɑksɪz steɪd ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 還好，易碎箱一路都在最上層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty in, sixty out, all here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔsti ɪn ˈsɔsti ˈaʊt ɔl hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 上車六十、下車六十，全都在。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our whole life fits in sixty boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər hoʊl laɪf fɪts ɪn ˈsɔsti ˈbɑksɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我們的一生裝進六十箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did every tall box stay upright?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ˈɛvri tɔl bɑks steɪ ˈʌpˌraɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那些高的箱子一路都有立著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All upright, he drove so carefully.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ˈʌpˌraɪt hi draʊ soʊ ˈkɛrfəli/
dialogue.zh: 全都立著，他開得特別小心穩當。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The elevator's here, load it up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɛləˌveɪtərz hɪr loʊd ɪt ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 電梯來了，先把箱子往上裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half the boxes wait downstairs for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ðə bɑksɪz weɪt ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz fər naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一半的箱子先擱在樓下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, our new home!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt ɪz ˈaʊər nu hoʊm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe in, that's our twelve C door.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪð ɪn ðæts ˈaʊər twɛlv si dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 深呼吸，那就是我們十二 C 的門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Key in the lock, we're standing inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ki ɪn ðə lɑk wɪr ˈstændɪŋ ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 鑰匙一轉，我們站進了新家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wow, the floors are all brand new.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðə flɔrz ɑr ɔl brænd nu/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sunlight everywhere, nothing blocks the windows.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌnˌlaɪt ˈɛvriˌwɛr ˈnʌθɪŋ blɑks ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 滿屋陽光，窗戶毫無遮擋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worth every box we carried today.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrθ ˈɛvri bɑks wi ˈkærid təˈdeɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should the sofa face exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd ðə ˈsoʊfə feɪs ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 沙發到底該朝哪個方向？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Against the long wall, pointing inward.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡɛnst ðə lɔŋ wɔl ˈpɔɪntɪŋ ˈɪnˌwərd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: As for the dining table, window side.
dialogue.phonetic: /æz fər ðə ˈdaɪnɪŋ ˈteɪbəl ˈwɪnˌdoʊ saɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the chairs can face the view.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə tʃɛrz kæn feɪs ðə vju/
dialogue.zh: 椅子就能對著窗外美景。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read the color labels, sort the boxes.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ðə ˈkʌlər ˈleɪbəlz sɔrt ðə ˈbɑksɪz/
dialogue.zh: 照顏色標籤把箱子分好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red straight to the kitchen, blue bedroom.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛd streɪt tə ðə ˈkɪtʃən blu ˈbɛdˌrum/
dialogue.zh: 紅色直接進廚房，藍色臥室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green boxes line up in the office.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡrin ˈbɑksɪz laɪn ʌp ɪn ði ˈɔfɪs/
dialogue.zh: 綠色箱子在書房排成一列。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nothing belongs in the hallway, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ bɪˈlɔŋz ɪn ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 走廊裡什麼都不該放，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only the mattress leans in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə ˈmætrɪs linz ɪn ðə hɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bed frame goes up tonight, remember.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɛd freɪm ɡoʊz ʌp təˈnaɪt rɪˈmɛmbər/
dialogue.zh: 床架今晚要組好，記得喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the crew finish their paperwork?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə kru ˈfɪnɪʃ ðɛr ˈpeɪpərˌwɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 搬運隊的單據辦完了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Signed and paid, they were great.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪnd ænd peɪd ðeɪ wɜr ɡreɪt/
dialogue.zh: 簽收了也付了，他們超棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's flatten the empty boxes outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ˈflætn ði ˈɛmpti ˈbɑksɪz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The recycling comes Thursday morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈsaɪklɪŋ kʌmz ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 資源回收週四早上來收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee first, box thirty-one has the mugs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi fɜrst bɑks ˈθɜrdi wʌn hæz ðə mʌɡz/
dialogue.zh: 先來咖啡，三十一號有杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, cut the tape from the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl kʌt ðə teɪp frʌm ðə saɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Not one chip, look at that.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt wʌn tʃɪp lʊk æt ðæt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your wrapping skills paid off today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔr ˈræpɪŋ skɪlz peɪd ɔf təˈdeɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the soup bowls go here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ðə sup boʊlz ɡoʊ hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lower cabinet, closer to the stove.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈloʊər ˈkæbənət ˈkloʊsər tə ðə stoʊv/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forks on the right, knives on the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔrks ɑn ðə raɪt naɪvz ɑn ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 叉子放右邊，刀子放左邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The drawers slide so smooth here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə drɔərz slaɪd soʊ smuð hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check out this new fridge, so huge.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk aʊt ðɪs nu frɪdʒ soʊ hjuʤ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And it makes ice all by itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪt meɪks aɪs ɔl baɪ ɪtˈsɛlf/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's set up the cooking pans now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts sɛt ʌp ðə ˈkʊkɪŋ pænz naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lids need that rack from box nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɪdz nid ðæt ræk frʌm bɑks naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 鍋蓋要用九號箱的架子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bedroom boxes wait till we eat something.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛdˌrum ˈbɑksɪz weɪt tɪl wi it ˈsʌmθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 臥室的箱子等吃過再拆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, but the bed goes up tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid bʌt ðə bɛd ɡoʊz ʌp təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 同意，但床今晚一定要組好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count the bed parts on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðə bɛd pɑrts ɑn ðə flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 床的零件倒出來數一數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight pieces, two rails, one headboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈpisɪz tu reɪlz wʌn ˈhɛdˌbɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 八個零件、兩根邊軌、一塊床頭板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says to start with the frame.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz tə stɑrt wɪð ðə freɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long screw first, then tighten it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ skru fɜrst ðɛn ˈtaɪtən ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand me the small wrench, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd mi ðə smɔl rɛntʃ pliz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, and hold the board steady.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ænd hoʊld ðə bɔrd ˈstɛdi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This headboard sits between those two hooks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈhɛdˌbɔrd sɪts bɪˈtwin ðoz tu hʊks/
dialogue.zh: 床頭板卡進那兩個鉤子間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, our bed already stands strong.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ˈaʊər bɛd ɔlˈrɛdi stændz strɔŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bring the mattress in, bend it slightly.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ ðə ˈmætrɪs ɪn bɛnd ɪt ˈslaɪtli/
dialogue.zh: 把床墊搬進來，稍微彎一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat and perfect, it fits exactly.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt ænd ˈpɜrfɪkt ɪt fɪts ɪɡˈzæktli/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One pillow, one sheet, we're set tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈpɪloʊ wʌn ʃit wɪr sɛt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一個枕頭一條單人床包，今晚夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The other boxes can wait for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈʌðər ˈbɑksɪz kæn weɪt fər naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the lamp on the side table.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə læmp ɑn ðə saɪd ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 現在把台燈放上床邊桌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Warm light, this corner feels like home.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔrm laɪt ðɪs ˈkɔrnər filz laɪk hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 暖光一亮，這角落就有家的感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This big cabinet needs two to lift.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bɪɡ ˈkæbənət nidz tu tə lɪft/
dialogue.zh: 這個大櫃子要兩個人才抬得動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lift with your knees, not your back.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪft wɪð jɔr niz nɑt jɔr bæk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That fits our bedroom wall at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt fɪts ˈaʊər ˈbɛdˌrum wɔl æt læst/
dialogue.zh: 終於貼著臥室的牆放正了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now hang the curtains before dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ hæŋ ðə ˈkɜrtənz bɪˈfɔr dɑrk/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Curtain rod first, it squeezes inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɜrtən rɑd fɜrst ɪt skwizɪz ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 先裝簾桿，它撐進窗框裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn and lock, done in one try.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ænd lɑk dʌn ɪn wʌn traɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thick curtains wait; the thin ones go up.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪk ˈkɜrtənz weɪt ði θɪn wʌnz ɡoʊ ʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even length at both ends, so neat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən lɛŋθ æt boʊθ ɛndz soʊ nit/
dialogue.zh: 兩邊一般長，整齊得舒心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We rent, so no drilling in walls.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi rɛnt soʊ noʊ ˈdrɪlɪŋ ɪn wɔlz/
dialogue.zh: 租的房子，不能往牆上鑽孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sticky hooks will save our deposit then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɪki hʊks wɪl seɪv ˈaʊər dɪˈpɑzɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那就用無痕黏鉤保住押金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the TV on this low shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə ˌtiˈvi ɑn ðɪs loʊ ʃɛlf/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same photo, same ports, plug it in.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈfoʊtoʊ seɪm pɔrts plʌɡ ɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 照片跟插孔都一樣，插回去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Picture bright, sound clear, we're lucky.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɪktʃər braɪt saʊnd klɪr wɪr ˈlʌki/
dialogue.zh: 畫面亮、聲音清，我們真幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now give me that tape and scissors.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɡiv mi ðæt teɪp ænd ˈsɪzərz/
dialogue.zh: 現在把那捲膠帶和剪刀給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the cat still in her carrier?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə kæt stɪl ɪn hɜr ˈkɛriər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she's awake and asking for food.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ʃiz əˈweɪk ænd ˈæskɪŋ fər fuːd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Food and water go in the kitchen corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /fuːd ænd ˈwɔtər ɡoʊ ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃən ˈkɔrnər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, that's her spot for life.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ðæts hɜr spɑt fər laɪf/
dialogue.zh: 安置好了，那是她的固定地盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any paper towels packed somewhere?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnɪ ˈpeɪpər ˈtaʊərz pækt ˈsʌmwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 廚房紙巾有打包在哪裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The last box, the one marked first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læst bɑks ði wʌn mɑrkt fɜrst/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open it, we'll need them all night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt wil nid ðɛm ɔl naɪt/
dialogue.zh: 開了它吧，整晚都用得到。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And one box for all the trash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd wʌn bɑks fər ɔl ðə træʃ/
dialogue.zh: 再留一個箱裝所有垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which box has the toilet soap?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ bɑks hæz ðə ˈtɔɪlət soʊp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine, I'm carrying it right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn aɪm ˈkæriɪŋ ɪt raɪt naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New bathroom, same old rubber duck.
dialogue.phonetic: /nu ˈbæθˌrum seɪm oʊld ˈrʌbər dʌk/
dialogue.zh: 新的浴室，舊的洗澡小黃鴨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's been with us for fifteen years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts bɪn wɪð ʌs fər fɪfˈtin jɪrz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Toothbrushes stay in the bedside drawer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtuːθˌbrʌʃɪz steɪ ɪn ðə ˈbɛdˌsaɪd drɔər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Night lights too, we have three of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪt laɪts tu wi hæv θri əv ðɛm/
dialogue.zh: 小夜燈也是，我們帶了三個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wardrobe boxes keep the clothes on hangers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔrˌdroʊb bɑksɪz kip ðə kloʊðz ɑn ˈhæŋərz/
dialogue.zh: 衣櫥箱讓衣服掛在原本的衣架。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just hang them up, nothing to fold.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst hæŋ ðɛm ʌp ˈnʌθɪŋ tə foʊld/
dialogue.zh: 直接掛進櫃子，一件都不用折。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Closet doors open wide, plenty of space.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɑsət dɔrz ˈoʊpən waɪd ˈplɛnti əv speɪs/
dialogue.zh: 衣櫃門大開，空間多得很。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My shirts finally have room to breathe.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ʃɜrts ˈfaɪnəli hæv rum tə brið/
dialogue.zh: 我的襯衫終於能透口氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here, the desk goes by the quiet window.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðə dɛsk ɡoʊz baɪ ðə ˈkwaɪət ˈwɪnˌdoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 書桌就放在安靜那側窗邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lamp, laptop, chair, done in ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /læmp ˈlæpˌtɑp tʃɛr dʌn ɪn tɛn ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 台燈、筆電、椅子，十分鐘搞定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Books were heavy, so boxes stayed small.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊks wɜr ˈhɛvi soʊ ˈbɑksɪz steɪd smɔl/
dialogue.zh: 書太重，所以每箱都裝得小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart move, stacking them was easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt muːv ˈstækɪŋ ðɛm wəz ˈizi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shelf one for novels, two for work files.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɛlf wʌn fər ˈnɑːvəlz tu fər wɜrk faɪlz/
dialogue.zh: 第一層放小說，第二層放文件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The rest go in the closed cabinet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɛst ɡoʊ ɪn ðə kloʊzd ˈkæbənət/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the mugs wrapped in towels?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə mʌɡz ræpt ɪn ˈtaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 馬克杯有用毛巾包著嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, row by row, box thirty-one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs roʊ baɪ roʊ bɑks ˈθɜrdi wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 有，一排排夾好，在三十一號箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kitchen nearly done, take a break.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɪtʃən ˈnɪrli dʌn teɪk ə breɪk/
dialogue.zh: 廚房快弄完了，休息一下吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll order pizza for the whole crew.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl ˈɔrdər ˈpitsə fər ðə hoʊl kru/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two large pepperoni, extra cheese, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu lɑrdʒ ˌpɛpərˈoʊni ˈɛkstrə tʃiz pliz/
dialogue.zh: 兩份大號薩拉米披薩，多加起司。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And a big salad, we earned it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə bɪɡ ˈsæləd wi ɜrnd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 再加份大沙拉，我們當之無愧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we eat tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd wi it təˈnaɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The balcony, pizza on our laps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbælkəni ˈpitsə ɑn ˈaʊər læps/
dialogue.zh: 就在陽台，披薩攤在腿上吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at the whole city below us.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə hoʊl ˈsɪti bɪˈloʊ ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 看，整個城市就在我們腳下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve floors up, best view ever.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv flɔrz ʌp bɛst vju ˈɛvər/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All these boxes can wait till morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ðiz bɑksɪz kæn weɪt tɪl ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 這些箱子留到早上再拆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The night is ours, relax first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə naɪt ɪz ˈaʊərz rɪˈlæks fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 今晚是我們自己的，先放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you hear that? Nothing at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju hɪr ðæt ˈnʌθɪŋ æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 你聽見了嗎？什麼聲音都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No street noise, just the fridge hum.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ striːt nɔɪz dʒʌst ðə frɪdʒ hʌm/
dialogue.zh: 沒有街上噪音，只有冰箱低鳴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love it here already.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ɪt hɪr ɔlˈrɛdi/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, home sweet new home.
dialogue.phonetic: /mi tu hoʊm swiːt nu hoʊm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First things first, the change of address.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst θɪŋz fɜrst ðə tʃeɪndʒ əv əˈdrɛs/
dialogue.zh: 第一步，先把登記地址改掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The website makes it really easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɛbˌsaɪt meɪks ɪt ˈrɪli ˈizi/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Old flat first, then the new one.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld flæt fɜrst ðɛn ðə nu wʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then all the mail comes to us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɔl ðə meɪl kʌmz tə ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 這樣所有郵件都會轉來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does the forwarding last?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ dʌz ðə ˈfɔrwərdɪŋ læst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A whole year, plenty of time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə hoʊl jɪr ˈplɛnti əv taɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, I hate lost letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt aɪ heɪt lɔst ˈlɛtərz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bills and packages, all moved now.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪlz ænd ˈpækɪdʒɪz ɔl muːvd naʊ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who updates the bank and insurance?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ˈʌpˌdeɪts ðə bæŋk ænd ɪnˈʃʊrəns/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, one more form each.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du wʌn mɔr fɔrm itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 我們自己辦，各填一張表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone number stays the same.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ˈnʌmbər steɪz ðə seɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And doctors and dentists too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈdɑktərz ænd ˈdɛntɪsts tu/
dialogue.zh: 還有診所和牙醫也要改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, the old trash service must end.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ ði oʊld træʃ ˈsɜrvɪs mʌst ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 還有，舊家的垃圾清運今天得停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, one phone call did it all.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn wʌn foʊn kɔl dɪd ɪt ɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about our newspaper subscription?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈaʊər ˈnuzˌpeɪpər səbˈskrɪpʃən/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cancel that one, we never read it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkænsl ðʌt wʌn wi ˈnɛvər rid ɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our online accounts need one update.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˌɑnˈlaɪn əˈkaʊnts nid wʌn ˈʌpˌdeɪt/
dialogue.zh: 網路帳戶統一改一次就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shop and food delivery, done twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɑp ænd fuːd dɪˈlɪvəri dʌn twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 購物和送餐，兩個都改好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who sets up the electricity first?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu sɛts ʌp ði ɪlɛkˈtrɪsəti fɜrst/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call the power company this morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ðə ˈpaʊər ˈkʌmpəni ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 今天一早就打給電力公司。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They need the move-in date.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ nid ðə ˈmuːv ɪn deɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Today is the date, luckily.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈdeɪ ɪz ðə deɪt ˈlʌkɪli/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Water and gas on the same call?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtər ænd ɡæs ɑn ðə seɪm kɔl/
dialogue.zh: 水和瓦斯也同一通辦嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, two more companies, two forms.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ tu mɔr ˈkʌmpəniz tu fɔrmz/
dialogue.zh: 不行，另兩家公司各一張表。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By the way, the internet is booked.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ ðə weɪ ði ˈɪntərˌnɛt ɪz bʊkt/
dialogue.zh: 對了，網路方案早就約好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A technician comes tomorrow afternoon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə tɛkˈnɪʃən kʌmz təˈmɑroʊ ˌæftərˈnun/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time window did they give?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt taɪm ˈwɪnˌdoʊ dɪd ðeɪ ɡɪv/
dialogue.zh: 他們給的時間區間是幾點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Between one and five, we'll wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈtwin wʌn ænd faɪv wil weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一點到五點之間，我們等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our router is in the office box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈraʊtər ɪz ɪn ði ˈɔfɪs bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 我們的分享器在書房那一箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Modem, cables, remote, all in one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmoʊdəm ˈkeɪbəlz rɪˈmoʊt ɔl ɪn wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 數據機、線、遙控器全在一箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the wifi reach the bedroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ ritʃ ðə ˈbɛdˌrum/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plan says strong in every room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə plæn sɛz strɔŋ ɪn ˈɛvri rum/
dialogue.zh: 方案說每個房間訊號都強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the best spot for the router?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛrz ðə bɛst spɑt fər ðə ˈraʊtər/
dialogue.zh: 分享器放在哪裡訊號最好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The hall shelf, middle of everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɔl ʃɛlf ˈmɪdəl əv ˈɛvriθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 走廊那層架，正好在中間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we pay the new deposit?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi peɪ ðə nu dɪˈpɑzɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lease signed, deposit paid, keys ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /lis saɪnd dɪˈpɑzɪt peɪd kiz ˈaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 簽約繳押金，鑰匙歸我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three keys, one for the mailbox.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri kiz wʌn fər ðə ˈmeɪlˌbɑks/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Number twelve C, on the brass tag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbər twɛlv si ɑn ðə bræs tæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 黃銅牌上寫著十二 C。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the mailbox, downstairs?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈmeɪlˌbɑks ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lobby case, third row from the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɑbi keɪs θɜrd roʊ frʌm ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 大廳那排櫃，左數第三列。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the rent due date here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌts ðə rɛnt du deɪt hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The first, paid online, no checks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɜrst peɪd ˌɑnˈlaɪn noʊ tʃɛks/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they allow pets in the building?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ əˈlaʊ pɛts ɪn ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the lease already lists her.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə lis ɔlˈrɛdi lɪsts hɜr/
dialogue.zh: 允許，租賃本上已寫著貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet hours start at ten sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət aʊərz stɑrt æt tɛn ʃɑrp/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our move noise stayed within the rules.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər muv nɔɪz steɪd wɪˈðɪn ðə rulz/
dialogue.zh: 我們搬家的吵聲都在規範內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a fee for the gym?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə fi fər ðə dʒɪm/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free for tenants, open every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri fər ˈtɛnənts ˈoʊpən ˈɛvri deɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Laundry room is on floor two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɔndri rum ɪz ɑn flɔr tu/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Coins, or the app, both work.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔɪnz ɔr ði æp boʊθ wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 硬幣或用 App 都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Trash bins go out on Tuesday nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /træʃ bɪnz ɡoʊ ˈaʊt ɑn ˈtuzˌdeɪ naɪts/
dialogue.zh: 垃圾桶週二晚上搬出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Recycling waits inside till Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈsaɪklɪŋ weɪts ɪnˈsaɪd tɪl ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 資源回收先放著，週四再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Someone is knocking, open the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmwʌn ɪz ˈnɑkɪŋ ˈoʊpən ðə dɔr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh hi, welcome to the building!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ haɪ ˈwɛlkəm tə ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 喔你好，歡迎搬來這一棟！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm from twelve C, upstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm frʌm twɛlv si ˌʌpˈstɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我們是樓上十二 C。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're eleven C, right below you.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr ɪˈlɛvən si raɪt bɪˈloʊ ju/
dialogue.zh: 我們是十一 C，就在你們下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We moved in this morning actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi muːvd ɪn ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 我們其實今早才剛搬來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How do you like it so far?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du ju laɪk ɪt soʊ fɑr/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bright and quiet, we love it.
dialogue.phonetic: /braɪt ænd ˈkwaɪət wi lʌv ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 又亮又安靜，我們很喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm Sam, this is my wife Meg.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm sæm ðɪs ɪz maɪ waɪf mɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我叫 Sam，這是我太太 Meg。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You've lived here so long, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /juv lɪvd hɪr soʊ lɔŋ ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那你們住在這裡很久了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, longer than we expected.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈlɔŋɡər ðæn wi ɪkˈspɛktɪd/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So you must know the good spots nearby.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ju mʌst noʊ ðə ɡʊd spɑts ˌnɪrˈbaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那附近有哪些好去處，你們一定知道。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The corner grocery has the best deals.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɔrnər ˈɡroʊsəri hæz ðə bɛst dilz/
dialogue.zh: 街角那家雜貨店最划算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a car needed around here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ə kɑr ˈnidɪd əˈraʊnd hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, buses stop right downstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈbʌsəz stɑp raɪt ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How late does the metro run?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ leɪt dʌz ðə ˈmitroʊ rʌn/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Past midnight, two blocks from here.
dialogue.phonetic: /pæst ˈmɪdˌnaɪt tu blɑks frʌm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 過午夜，離這只兩個街口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the friendliest coffee place?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛrz ðə ˈfrɛndli ˈkɔfi pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 最有人情味的咖啡廳在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blue Pot on Fifth, ask for Lena.
dialogue.phonetic: /blu pɑt ɑn fɪfθ æsk fər ˈlinə/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, we'll need friends down here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt wil nid frɛndz daʊn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們在這裡正需要朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dinner at ours next Saturday, the four of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪnər æt ˈaʊərz nɛkst ˈsætərˌdeɪ ðə fɔr əv ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 下週六到我們家吃飯，我們四個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're free after six, that works.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr fri ˈæftər sɪks ðæt wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 我們六點後都有空，正好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come hungry, Meg cooks too much.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm ˈhʌŋɡri mɛɡ kʊks tu mʌtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 記得空腹來，Meg 煮得超豐盛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the building party in June?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈpɑrti ɪn dʒun/
dialogue.zh: 大樓六月的聯誼活動呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, snacks and games in the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs snæks ænd ɡeɪmz ɪn ðə hɔl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they give you the rules booklet?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðeɪ ɡɪv ju ðə rulz ˈbʊklɪt/
dialogue.zh: 他們給你住戶規範小冊了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, parking and elevator hours inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈpɑrkɪŋ ænd ˈɛləˌveɪtər ˈaʊərz ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 有，停車和電梯時間都在裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So guests park in the front spots?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ɡɛsts pɑrk ɪn ðə frʌnt spɑts/
dialogue.zh: 那訪客就停前面那排車位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, register their plates with the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈrɛdʒɪstər ðɛr pleɪts wɪð ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 對，車牌要先到管理台登記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And packages go to the lobby shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ˈpækɪdʒɪz ɡoʊ tə ðə ˈlɑbi ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 包裹都放在大廳的架上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the shelf twice every day.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ʃɛlf twaɪs ˈɛvri deɪ/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more knock, it's Sam again.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr nɑk ɪts sæm əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 又一聲敲門，是 Sam 回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Come in, Sam, we'll bring the tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌm ɪn sæm wil brɪŋ ðə ti/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fridge hums low, and the cat naps.
dialogue.phonetic: /frɪdʒ hʌmz loʊ ænd ðə kæt næps/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Peace at last after that huge move.
dialogue.phonetic: /pis æt læst ˈæftər ðæt hjuʤ muv/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, unpack the bedroom and office.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ ʌnˈpæk ðə ˈbɛdˌrum ænd ˈɔfɪs/
dialogue.zh: 明天拆臥室和書房的箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the small stuff, little by little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə smɔl stʌf ˈlɪtəl baɪ ˈlɪtəl/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's Biscuit's dish for tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛrz ˈbɪskɪts dɪʃ fər təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: Biscuit 今晚的飯碗在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the red box, marked kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə rɛd bɑks mɑrkt ˈkɪtʃən/
dialogue.zh: 在紅色那箱，標著廚房的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leave the boxes out for Thursday.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ðə bɑksɪz aʊt fər ˈθɜrzˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那些紙箱放到外面等週四收。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the hall stays clear tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə hɔl steɪz klɪr təˈnaɪt/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Biscuit found a sunny corner already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɪskɪt faʊnd ə ˈsʌni ˈkɔrnər ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: Biscuit 已經找到向陽的角落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's asleep in it, our traveling cat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiz əˈslip ɪn ɪt ˈaʊər ˈtrævəlɪŋ kæt/
dialogue.zh: 牠已經睡進去了，我們這隻旅行貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A new street, a new start for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nu strit ə nu stɑrt fər ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 新的一條街，我們的新開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The same bed, the same two mugs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə seɪm bɛd ðə seɪm tu mʌɡz/
dialogue.zh: 同一張床，同兩顆馬克杯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sixty boxes and everything fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔsti ˈbɑksɪz ænd ˈɛvriθɪŋ fɪts/
dialogue.zh: 六十個箱子，全都放得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sixty more and we'd need a warehouse.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔsti mɔr ænd wid nid ə ˈwɛrˌhaʊs/
dialogue.zh: 再多六十個就得租倉庫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready to sleep, ready to dream.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi tə slip ˈrɛdi tə drim/
dialogue.zh: 準備好入睡，也準備好作夢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, welcome to apartment twelve C.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt ˈwɛlkəm tə əˈpɑrtmənt twɛlv si/
dialogue.zh: 晚安，歡迎入住十二 C。
